Saco2026SelfNormalizedAdaptiveExperiments, Theorem 5.14, already proves a fixed-horizon realized-QV Studentized CLT without deterministic variance stabilization; the proposed advance is restricted to uniform verification from a finite-attractor recursion.

ShenEtAl2026DirectionalStability supplies target-specific deterministic directional stability, while Teicher1963FiniteMixtureIdentification supplies mixture identifiability; neither states this every-nominal-level finite-basin coverage converse.

GuoXu2026MisspecifiedBandits deterministic-stability inference and Saco2026SelfNormalizedAdaptiveExperiments fixed-horizon self-normalization contain this ordinary stable-policy regime.

Borkar2002LockIn gives lock-in bounds for a prescribed attraction domain; Pemantle1990UnstablePoints concerns unstable-point avoidance; GuoXu2026MisspecifiedBandits gives the motivating clipped-LinUCB numerical pathology, not a shrinking separatrix-margin frontier.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 2 / definition realized-QV sandwich
soundness_flags.one_line: \(\widehat V_T\) invokes \(\widehat H_T^{-1}\) without defining it on the non-negligible finite-sample event that \(\widehat H_T\) is singular; define a regularized/generalized inverse or state the statistic on an explicit invertibility event.

soundness_flags.label: Theorems 1--2 uniformity claim
soundness_flags.one_line: The class permits law-specific \(B,h_-,L_\Pi,p_-,\omega_\pm\) and law-specific approximate-root remainders, so its stated member conditions do not specify the common constants and root/separation controls required by a uniform-over-\(\mathfrak P_T\) assertion.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorems 1--4 and the proposed field-tier kernel
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The finite tail-selection, positive-basin-mass, and uniform Cesaro-attraction conditions are assumed as a conditional finite-attractor regime; the proposal does not establish that the exact Gaussian-noise Guo--Xu recursion satisfies them.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Conditional finite-attractor inference frontier, with field-tier scope until the separatrix OEQ derives the regime for the named recursion.

The paper introduces target-specific directional stability, weaker than full-matrix stability, and derives normal and efficient scalar inference once the relevant predictable quadratic variation stabilizes.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 1, Abstract; pp. 6--7, equations (6)--(7) and variance-stabilizing matrices
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The method targets misspecified adaptive off-policy M-estimation using predictable covariance-normalizing matrices estimated in a two-step procedure, including unstable/nonconvergent behavior policies.

The published article studies a stochastic-approximation recursion with finitely many possible limits and gives a lower bound on convergence to a prescribed point in its attraction domain; the exact theorem text was not publicly inspectable in this review.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Make the uniform class genuinely uniform: bind common numerical envelopes for score, Jacobian, policy Lipschitzness, basin mass, covariance eigenvalues, root separation, and the empirical-root remainder; then state the resulting explicit uniform error bound in terms of \(r_T+\delta_T\).
Repair the feasible studentizer by defining a ridge-regularized or event-truncated sandwich and proving that its regularization event is asymptotically inactive uniformly over the revised class.

Elevate the separatrix OEQ into a concrete Guo--Xu result by proposing a candidate \(\rho_T\) rate from the mean-ODE unstable eigenvalue and proving either a margin-trimmed upper bound or a matching delayed-lock-in lower construction.

recommended_next_step: Revise the two well-posedness defects, retain the finite-attractor theorem as a conditional field-tier kernel, then advance the repaired angle to Stage 0.
